validation: Check source years, county keys, hotel revenue measure/units and join compatibility with the DOR and QCEW panel.

actions.description: Clarify the exact FDLE population-estimate source because the official public product reviewed is a convictions dataset, not documented county-year population data.

Confirm the measure, fields fips/year/population, county coverage and overlap/duplication rules; do not substitute the public convictions product.
Acquire or reconstruct only the documented tables after the population source is established.

actions.description: Obtain the STR county-to-FIPS match file and its matching/coverage rules.
